title: GassedUp.io - Gas Station Simulator
author: LastAd6063
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’ve been working on [**GassedUp.io**](http://GassedUp.io), a browser-based gas station and business management game inspired by games like Prison Architect.

It’s still **very much a work in progress**, and I’m at the point where I’d really love some outside feedback. I’m looking for thoughts on the gameplay, UI, balance, bugs, confusing systems, or anything that could simply make the game more fun.

Development has been a mix of **traditional coding, custom artwork and assets from artists, and Claude AI**, which I’ve been using as a development tool to help prototype ideas, work through systems, troubleshoot code, and shape parts of the game as it grows.

If you feel like giving it a try, you can play it here:

[**https://GassedUp.io**](https://gassedup.io/)

Any feedback is genuinely appreciated. ⛽🏗️
